_note: Roman Hinglish subtitles per scene (shown in chunks while the scene's voice plays; reels are mostly watched without sound).
hook: Abhi is waqt, hackers aapki website scan kar rahe hain. Bas ek kamzori dhoondhne ke liye.
threats: SQL injection, XSS, remote code execution. Zyada tar websites ko pata bhi nahi chalta.
manual: Manual testing slow hai, mehengi hai, isliye log ise skip kar dete hain.
intro: Miliye Tech Guardians VAPT se. Minutes mein poori website ka scan.
plug: Bas URL daalo, aur Start dabao. Na setup, na database. Pendrive se bhi chalta hai.
vapt: Apne aap poora Vulnerability Assessment aur Penetration Test. Headers, TLS, exposed files, sab check.
confirm: Aur real flaws ko proof ke saath confirm karta hai.
report: Phir milta hai professional PDF report. OWASP, CVSS, CERT-In aur DPDP ke mutaabik, fix plan ke saath.
sell: Portable, rebrandable, aur sell karne ke liye ready.
who: Agency ho, freelancer ho ya business — dino ka kaam, ab minutes mein.
cta: Tech Guardians VAPT. Aaj hi apni website scan karo.
